stem.text: Ethyl propanoate is refluxed with aqueous sodium hydroxide. The alcohol produced is then reacted with methyl propanoic acid to make a second ester.
What is the structural formula of this second ester?

A.alt: Displayed formula of CH3CH2OC(=O)CH(CH3)CH3: an ethyl ester of 2-methylpropanoic acid

B.alt: Displayed formula of CH3CH2CH2OC(=O)CH(CH3)CH3: a propyl ester of 2-methylpropanoic acid

C.alt: Displayed formula of CH3C(=O)OCH2CH(CH3)CH3: an ethanoate ester of 2-methylpropan-1-ol

D.alt: Displayed formula of CH3CH2C(=O)OCH2CH(CH3)CH3: a propanoate ester of 2-methylpropan-1-ol
